who: David M. P. Freund, historian of urban development and public policy at the University of Maryland; PhD Michigan, 1999.

evidence.says: LC identifies David M. P. Freund as the author of Colored Property and cites the Maryland history directory identifying David Freund as associate professor.
Maryland lists David Freund as associate professor of history and identifies Colored Property among his publications.
The 2012–2013 faculty catalogue lists David Freund, associate professor of history, with a University of Michigan–Ann Arbor PhD in 1999.

notes: Authority, book, department, period and doctorate agree; select the David M. P. candidate.

who: Daniel J. Gargola, historian of ancient Rome at the University of Kentucky; PhD North Carolina, 1988.

The university list of faculty eligible to serve, indexed as 2002, includes Daniel Gargola among history faculty.

who: Darren E. Grem, historian of the modern American South at the University of Mississippi; PhD Georgia, 2010.

who: Robert W. Hayman, historian of Rhode Island and the Diocese of Providence, formerly associate professor of history at Providence College; PhD Providence College.

evidence.says: LC identifies Robert W. Hayman, author of Catholicism in Rhode Island and the Diocese of Providence, and records an MA and PhD from Providence College.

notes: Full name, works, institution and doctorate identify the Robert W. candidate. The checked sources do not independently establish the supplied 1977 degree year.

who: Tessie P. Liu, historian of modern France and gender at Northwestern University; PhD Michigan, 1987.
